title: Specialty Pharmacy Program: Free Reshipment of Missed, Damaged or Temperature-Compromised Deliveries
content:
**Rule.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, a delivery that is missed, damaged or arrives outside its temperature range is reshipped at no charge when the member reports it no later than the tier's reporting window. The window is counted in calendar days after the scheduled delivery date, and that date is day zero.

- **Allowance.** Free reshipments for missed or damaged deliveries are limited to the tier's reshipment allowance per enrollment per plan year. Temperature excursions are always reshipped and never count against the allowance.
- **Once per reason.** Each shipped fill is reshipped at most once for the same reason.
- **Late reports.** A report made after the deadline is handled as an early refill under the plan's rules instead.

## How the gate is read

- **Anchor.** The anchor is the scheduled delivery date of the shipped fill being replaced, as the fill records show it.
- **Counting.** Calendar days are counted, and the scheduled delivery date is day zero.
- **Boundary.** The report date must be *no later than* day N, where N is the tier's reporting window. A report on day N itself is in time. A report on day N plus one is late.
- **Counting the allowance.** The allowance counts reshipments on this enrollment whose reason is a missed delivery or damage, from the start date of the current plan year of the member's plan enrollment through today, inclusive.

## Boundary cases (assumed scheduled delivery date of May 4 and an assumed 7-day window)

| Report date | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|
| May 10 | day 6 | In time |
| May 11 | day 7 | In time; the boundary day qualifies |
| May 12 | day 8 | Late; handled as an early refill under the plan's rules |

## Allowance cases (assumed allowance of 2 per plan year, reported in time)

| Reshipments for missed or damaged deliveries already this plan year | Reason now reported | Free reshipment? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | damaged | Yes; this one brings the count to 2 |
| 2 | missed delivery | No; the allowance is used |
| 2 | temperature excursion | Yes; temperature excursions never count |

## Same fill, same reason

A fill already reshipped once for damage is not reshipped a second time for damage. A reshipment of that fill for a different reason is not prevented by this once-per-reason limit.
